column2: Turns traction control off. Ride gently on wet or loose ground until you know how it behaves.
column3: Il controllo della trazione verrà disattivato. Guida con prudenza su fondo bagnato o instabile finché non sai come si comporta il monopattino.
column4: Traction control will be deactivated. Ride with caution on wet or unstable surfaces until you know how the scooter behaves.

column2: Below 3 km/h, the motor can pull from a standstill as soon as you use the throttle.
column3: Sotto i 3 km/h, il motore può far partire il monopattino da fermo appena usi l'acceleratore.
column4: Below 3 km/h, the motor can make the scooter start from stationary as soon as you use the throttle.

column2: Turns motor braking off, so your brakes do more of the stopping.
column3: Il recupero di energia verrà disattivato: il motore smetterà di frenare e i freni dovranno lavorare di più per fermarti.
column4: Energy recovery will be deactivated: the motor will stop braking and the brakes will have to work harder to stop you.
